info.title: Smart Lost & Found API
info.description:
Backend for a campus **Smart Lost & Found** system.

Flow: `LOST report` + `FOUND report` -> **automatic scoring** -> admin verification -> **claim approved** -> item returned.

See `README.md` for the full data model, matching formulas and frontend integration notes.

MatchOut.title: MatchOut
MatchOut.description:
A scored LOST/FOUND pairing.

Students only ever receive ``score`` and ``band``; the full
``score_breakdown`` is reserved for admins (see :class:`MatchDetail`).

ReportStatus.title: ReportStatus
ReportStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a report.

LOST :  OPEN -> MATCHED -> CLAIMED -> RETURNED
FOUND:  OPEN -> MATCHED -> HANDED_OVER -> RETURNED
Any    -> CLOSED | EXPIRED
